text: Flash floods submerge NH44 stretch between Kurnool and Anantapur; commercial trucks stranded over 15km.
Multi-axle container trailer rollover blocks two lanes on Mumbai-Pune Expressway ghat section.
Dense radiation fog drops visibility to zero across NH48 near Gurugram; speed limits reduced to 30km/h.
Farmer union tractor march blocks toll booths on Western Peripheral Expressway near Kundli.
Scheduled flyover expansion causes 20-minute crawling traffic near Chennai Guindy industrial hub.
Cyclone Dana landfall triggers gale winds exceeding 100km/h across coastal NH16 in Balasore.
Major landslide damages retaining wall on NH10 connecting Siliguri to Gangtok, halting heavy freight.
Port truck drivers stage localized 3-hour sit-in at JNPT gate 4 over terminal gate automation glitches.
Brisk pre-monsoon showers bring cooling relief across Bengaluru Electronic City; arterial flyovers clear.
Toxic chemical tanker leak forces evacuation and temporary detour on Ahmedabad-Vadodara Expressway.
NHAI commences routine pothole resurfacing along NH52 between Jaipur and Kota with single-lane operation.
Severe dust storm with gusts up to 65km/h sweeps Bikaner-Jodhpur freight corridor, slowing container convoys.
Bridge structural inspection underway over Yamuna on NH19; freight vehicles diverted via Agra bypass.
Protestors block railway crossings and adjacent service roads near Ambala on GT Road.
Water pipeline rupture floods service lane on Outer Ring Road Hyderabad; express lanes open.
High temperature alert: daytime asphalt temperatures exceed 48C in Nagpur freight logistics park.
Tirunelveli-Madurai NH44 stretch closed after heavy monsoon discharge from Manimuthar dam.
Container trailer tire blowout sparks minor barrier fire on Samruddhi Mahamarg near Jalna; 1-hour delay.
Customs clearance software upgrade at Kolkata Port triggers 12-hour document backlog for export trailers.
Routine night toll plaza lane calibration at Khed Shivapur toll; minimal 5-minute passenger car queues.
Brahmaputra river spate breaches embankment, inundating NH27 between Nagaon and Kaziranga.
Dense smog warning across Delhi-Meerut Expressway; visual range down to 80m during early freight window.
Overturned LPG tanker creates hazardous exclusion zone on NH48 near Vapi; full corridor sealed.
Intermittent light drizzle reported around Coimbatore bypass; roads damp but freight movement brisk.
Unscheduled rail roko protest near Kanpur Central spills over to adjoining freight terminal feeder avenues.
Hill slip clears on Shiradi Ghat (NH75) after emergency earthmover deployment; restricted single-file transit.
Ferry services suspended between Ghogha and Dahej due to high sea swell; roll-on roll-off freight rerouted by road.
Heavy hailstorm damages windshields of parked trailers at Sonipat multi-modal logistics terminal.
Bridge expansion joint maintenance on Vidyasagar Setu restricts heavy commercial goods vehicles to night hours.
Clear skies and optimal road conditions reported across NH44 Hyderabad-Bengaluru highway segment.
